title: Old Faithful Doesn't Erupt Like Clockwork
post_title: Old Faithful Doesn't Erupt Like Clockwork | QuantaTale
post_description: The world's famous geyser is predictable—but not because it follows an exact hourly timer. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://www.nps.gov/yell/learn/nature/hydrothermal-features.htm https://www.usgs.gov/observatories/yvo/news/beyond-bathroom-top-visitor-questions-yellowstones-thermal-areas?page=0 #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: Old Faithful earned its name because its eruptions are unusually predictable for a geyser. But it does not erupt at exact hourly intervals. Yellowstone National Park says the interval can range from about 60 to 110 minutes, and predictions depend partly on the duration of the previous eruption. The underground plumbing and changing water circulation matter. It is a remarkable natural pattern, not a mechanical clock—and predictions still have a margin of error.
